about: Where the devnet price copier (scripts/testnet/solana/prices.ts) reads each test token's price and its average on mainnet, read only. Every entry it writes keeps the source's own value, exponent and unix time; a chain of entries is their product, stamped with the oldest of their times.

scope.source: Kamino Scope's price account on mainnet, the one fixtures/solana-vault/scope-indexes.json names

solana:syrupusdc.source: The price chain and the average chain of Kamino's syrupUSDC reserve AwCyCPZYJSZ93xcVKNK7jR8e1BHzJXq1D4bReNuh9woY (Maple market 6WEGfej9B9wjxRs6t4BYpb9iCXd8CpTpJ8fVSNzHCC5y): syrupUSDC in USDC (314) times USDC in dollars (13), read from the reserve on 2026-10-05

solana:jlusdc.source: Jupiter Lend's lending account for USDC and jlUSDC (program jup3YeL8QhtSx1e253b2FDvsMNC87fDrgQZivbrndc9): its token exchange price (USDC per jlUSDC, 1e12 precision) times Scope's USDC price (13) and USDC average (456), stamped with the older of the rate's last update and the Scope entry. The rate has no average of its own: the average entry is the same rate times USDC's average

solana:gldx.why: No honest fresh source on mainnet: GLDx has no Kamino reserve and so no Scope chain, its Pyth push account (FMGx9GMRAsAnFciE4HPHSMoWVZ6UgzmFJZ1nXdKVGH6e) was last updated about 23 days before 2026-10-05, and Pyth's Hermes service now asks for a key. Its placeholder stays.
